name: Laugh_1
short_caption: The robot leans forward, looks down, and shakes with gentle laughter before returning to its neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts by tilting its head up and slightly to its right while raising its right hand in a brief, expressive gesture. It then leans its torso forward, bows its head downward, and brings both hands near its midsection as if chuckling warmly. After a brief period of shaking its body slightly, the robot raises its head back up to look forward and gradually returns both arms to its sides in a neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot leans forward slightly and brings its hands together in front of its chest; ensure a small clearance zone in front of the chest tablet.
